        How Financial Auto-Reconciliation Operates
      

      

        

          1. Physical Statement Balance: Entered by the Treasurer directly from the official bank or fund statement along with the verification date.
        

        

          2. System Book Balance: Automatically summed from approved cash inflows (contributions, repayments) minus outflows (loan disbursements, expenses).
        

        

          3. Expense Offsets / Refunds: Handled seamlessly and excluded from physical bank inflows to keep bank reconciliations accurate.

Cryptographic Ledger Integrity & Tamper-Evident Audit Trail

                
                  Checking integrity...
                
              

              

                Transactions and audit trails are sealed sequentially with SHA-256 rolling cryptographic hashes to guarantee immutability against direct spreadsheet tampering.

            SHA-256 Rolling Chain
          

        


        
        

          

            
            CRITICAL: Cryptographic Chain Broken / Ledger Tampering Detected
          

          

            One or more audit trail rows have been modified, deleted, or inserted directly outside authorized dashboard RPCs. The hash chain linkage is compromised at the following records:
          

          

          

        


        
        

          
          

            

              

                
                

                  Entries older than this period are systematically archived to annual sheets with a preserved cryptographic checkpoint hash bridge.
                

              


              

                

                  
                  days
                

                

                  Default: 365 days. Enter 0 for permanent/infinite retention.
                

              

            


            

              
              Archival retains chain continuity via script property checkpoint bridges.
            

          


          
          

            

              

                
                
Cryptographic Tamper-Evidence Guarantee

              

              

                Every transaction, member modification, and policy change calculates a sequential rolling SHA-256 seal:
                
                  Hash_n = SHA-256(Hash_(n-1) | ts | actor | action | entity | id | summary | payload)
                
              

            


            

              
              Direct cell alterations immediately rupture the hash chain on next verification scan.
            

          

        

      

    


    
    

      

        Changes apply immediately to dynamic credit rules, member communications, and cryptographic audit retention policies.
